biotools.summary: askPulse federates pulse and legume data resources in one search and a public MCP server: Ensembl Plants genes for pea, faba bean, narrow-leafed lupin, common bean, cowpea, mungbean, pigeonpea, soybean, peanut and Medicago, chickpea and lentil genes and legume gene families from the Legume Information System, chickpea and pea expression atlases, QTL and GWAS (soybean, common bean, cowpea, peanut), the narrow-leafed lupin genetic map, INRAE GnpIS germplasm (FAIDARE), GBIF genebank accessions and Europe PMC literature, with gene and genome browser views.
